slides.title: What we are doing
bullets: Claude added new artifact types, including a Whiteboard (infinite canvas)
It has not shown up on my account: Pro plan, Mac desktop app
So we hunt for it: Settings, Capabilities, ask Claude, update the app and the Mac
Then we plan a week on a canvas with the tools that are already there

slides.title: Next: update
bullets: Quit and reopen Claude, then update the Mac

slides.title: One AI updating another
bullets: Update the system so new features can arrive
A script or a bot can run the Claude update
I use my own bot to update Claude on the MacBook Pro
One AI updates my other AI

slides.title: Keeping tools up to date
bullets: Check Claude is installed and current
My chief-of-staff bot, plus my own bots for repeat jobs
Watching my usage limit while the updates run

slides.title: Checking again
bullets: Artifacts: the Design tab and the Whiteboard are still not there

slides.title: Version check
bullets: Claude Desktop is up to date
Found an old broken copy and removed it
Updating the computer regularly helps

slides.title: Upgrade the system too
bullets: The upgrade also covers the system
Old copy removed: all good
Why: I want these new actions available

slides.title: While it updates
bullets: The update runs in the background
Claude keeps working meanwhile

slides.title: Claude builds the canvas
bullets: Claude names and fills in the sections
Double click any part to edit or comment

slides.title: Update finished
bullets: Close and reopen Claude
My bots get updates too: all agents keep updating

outro.title: Summary: what we learned
bullets: The Whiteboard is rolling out gradually: it had not reached my Pro account yet
There is no beta switch to flip: Settings, Capabilities had nothing for it
Update everything: quit and reopen Claude, update the Mac, remove old copies
Use the other artifact types meanwhile: Docs, Slides, Design and Data
